description: Arx REST API lockdown and plugin exposure for one hosted WordPress site (serviceId). get (default): the REST policy (mode off|guests|strict, the site's own allowed namespaces, the public base list, whether the web server part is active), the plugin's inventory summary (routes, namespaces and whether guests reach them, routes open to anyone, actions open to visitors), policy suggestions, and the plugin exposure audit (findings per plugin release with file:line and rule, known vulnerabilities). set (confirm): mode (guests = visitors who are not signed in reach only allowed namespaces, everything else answers 401; strict = also hides the route index and REST links from them; off) and allow (namespaces like booking/v2, replaces the site's own list; wp/v2 and batch/v1 cannot be opened). Signed-in users and application passwords are never limited. Nothing is blocked from audit findings on their own.

action.description: get is default. set needs confirm.

allow.description: set: the site's own allowed namespaces (e.g. booking/v2), on top of the public base list. Replaces the saved list.

mode.description: set: guests = visitors who are not signed in reach only allowed namespaces; strict = also no route index or REST links for them.

name: oma_arx_rest_api
title: Arx REST API lockdown
